---
title: "Errata"
subtitle: "On Green, Krasno, Coppock, Farrer, Lenoir and Zingher (2016), *Electoral Studies* 41"
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: green_etal_2016_errata.pdf
    geometry: margin=1.25in
    fontsize: 11pt
---

The maintained replication code behind these errata is at <https://github.com/active-maintenance-aec/green_etal_2016> and is archived at Zenodo at <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24168393>, a DOI that always resolves to the latest version.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
here::i_am("errata.qmd")

fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)

# Entry 1's corrected values are read from the maintained pipeline's output rather than
# typed here: text_exp1_merged_shares.R recomputes everything downstream of Experiment 1's
# vote shares with the merged precincts' shares taken from their summed vote counts.
merged_shares <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "text_exp1_merged_shares.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
corrected_value <- function(float_name, column_name, term_name) {
  value <- merged_shares$corrected[merged_shares$float == float_name &
                                     merged_shares$column == column_name &
                                     merged_shares$term == term_name]
  stopifnot(length(value) == 1)
  value
}
percent_points <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)

spillover_m1 <- corrected_value("Table 3", "Model 1", "Adjacent")
spillover_m1_se <- corrected_value("Table 3", "Model 1", "Adjacent SE")
spillover_m2 <- corrected_value("Table 3", "Model 2", "Adjacent")
spillover_m2_se <- corrected_value("Table 3", "Model 2", "Adjacent SE")
ri_p <- corrected_value("Section 5.1 text", "Experiment 1", "RI p-value")
agnostic_pr <- corrected_value("Figure 2", "Agnostic, Update 4", "pr(ATE>0)")
indirect_interaction <- corrected_value("Appendix D text", "Pooled interaction", "Adjacent estimate")

# The corrected sentence says the spillover estimate rises with covariates, which holds
# only while the recomputed estimates stand in this order.
stopifnot(spillover_m2 > spillover_m1, spillover_m2_se < spillover_m1_se)

# Pooled results are the conclusion's basis, and the note says they do not move as printed.
stopifnot(
  fmt(corrected_value("Table 7", "Pooled", "Treated estimate")) == "0.017",
  fmt(corrected_value("Table 7", "Pooled", "Treated std.error")) == "0.007",
  fmt(corrected_value("Table 7", "Pooled", "Adjacent estimate")) == "0.015",
  fmt(corrected_value("Table 7", "Pooled", "Adjacent std.error")) == "0.006"
)

# Every printed cell the correction moves, listed in entry 1's note from the output.
changed_cells <- merged_shares |>
  filter(float %in% c("Table 3", "Table 7", "Table D.5", "Figure 2"),
         fmt(published) != fmt(corrected)) |>
  mutate(
    label = str_replace_all(term, c(
      "condition_factorTreated:party_share" = "Assigned * Support",
      "condition_factorAdjacent:party_share" = "Adjacent * Support",
      "condition_factorTreated" = "Assigned Lawn Signs",
      "condition_factorAdjacent" = "Adjacent to Lawn Signs",
      "party_share" = "Past Party Support",
      "\\(Intercept\\)" = "Constant",
      "std\\.error" = "SE",
      " estimate" = ""
    )),
    change = str_glue("{label} {fmt(published)} to {fmt(corrected)}")
  )
changed_list <- changed_cells |>
  group_by(float, column) |>
  summarise(changes = str_c(change, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(float = fct_relevel(float, "Table 3", "Table 7", "Table D.5", "Figure 2")) |>
  arrange(float) |>
  transmute(sentence = str_glue("{float}, {column}: {changes}.")) |>
  pull(sentence) |>
  str_c(collapse = " ")

entry_1_claims <- c(
  "text_r1_spillover_m1", "text_r1_spillover_m1_se", "text_r1_spillover_m2", "text_r1_spillover_m2_se",
  "text_r1_ri_p", "text_agnostic_pr", "appd_pooled_indirect_interaction",
  "t3_m1_adjacent_coef", "t3_m1_adjacent_se", "t3_m1_r2", "t3_m2_adjacent_coef", "t3_m2_adjacent_se",
  "t3_m2_constant_coef", "t3_m2_constant_se", "t3_m2_r2",
  "t7_indirect_e1_coef", "t7_indirect_e1_se",
  "d5_e1_constant_coef", "d5_e1_constant_se", "d5_e1_treated_coef", "d5_e1_adjacent_coef", "d5_e1_adjacent_se",
  "d5_e1_support_coef", "d5_e1_support_se", "d5_e1_treated_x_coef", "d5_e1_treated_x_se",
  "d5_e1_adjacent_x_coef", "d5_e1_adjacent_x_se", "d5_e1_r2",
  "f2_agnostic_u1_mean", "f2_agnostic_u2_mean", "f2_optimist_u1_mean", "f2_optimist_u2_mean",
  "f2_agnostic_u2_pr", "f2_agnostic_u4_pr", "f2_skeptic_u1_pr", "f2_skeptic_u2_pr", "f2_skeptic_u3_pr"
)
stopifnot(sum(str_detect(entry_1_claims, "^(t3|t7|d5|f2)_")) == nrow(changed_cells))

# The covariate evidence is each table's Model 2 refit twice, once on past vote shares and
# once on the deposit's vote margin variables, recorded here because the deposit is
# downloaded rather than committed. When the deposit is present the chunk refits and refuses
# to render if the figures have moved. Tables 3 to 6 are the vote share models (entry 2);
# Tables C.1 to C.4 are the vote margin models (entry 5).
model_2_fits <- tribble(
  ~table, ~experiment, ~outcome, ~share_covariates, ~margin_covariates, ~printed_constant, ~printed_r2, ~share_constant, ~share_r2, ~margin_constant, ~margin_r2,
  "3", 1, "dvote12", "dvote10 + dvote08 + dvote06 + pvote08", "nvote10 + nvote08 + nvote06 + npvote08", 0.015, 0.823, 0.015, 0.823, 0.399, 0.550,
  "4", 2, "share", "registereddems + jenningsvoteshare09 + jenningsvoteshare05", "registereddems + jenningsvotemargin09 + jenningsvotemargin05", 0.287, 0.253, 0.287, 0.253, 0.614, 0.257,
  "5", 3, "share", "obama_share_2012 + shannon_share_2009", "obama_margin_2012 + shannon_margin_2009", 0.780, 0.825, 0.780, 0.825, 0.367, 0.716,
  "6", 4, "share", "GOVP2010 + USPP2008 + GOVP2006 + USPP2004 + GOVP2002 + USPP2000", "GOVM2010 + USPM2008 + GOVM2006 + USPM2004 + GOVM2002 + USPM2000", 0.532, 0.172, 0.532, 0.172, 0.566, 0.076,
  "C.1", 1, "nvote12", "dvote10 + dvote08 + dvote06 + pvote08", "nvote10 + nvote08 + nvote06 + npvote08", -60.879, 0.666, -183.440, 0.148, -60.879, 0.666,
  "C.2", 2, "margin", "registereddems + jenningsvoteshare09 + jenningsvoteshare05", "registereddems + jenningsvotemargin09 + jenningsvotemargin05", -30.993, 0.501, -116.141, 0.455, -30.993, 0.501,
  "C.3", 3, "margin", "obama_share_2012 + shannon_share_2009", "obama_margin_2012 + shannon_margin_2009", -256.773, 0.652, 542.690, 0.412, -256.773, 0.652,
  "C.4", 4, "margin", "GOVP2010 + USPP2008 + GOVP2006 + USPP2004 + GOVP2002 + USPP2000", "GOVM2010 + USPM2008 + GOVM2006 + USPM2004 + GOVM2002 + USPM2000", -19.087, 0.627, -220.707, 0.203, -19.087, 0.627
)

if (file.exists(here("original", "exp_1.RData"))) {
  walk(1:4, function(i) load(here("original", str_glue("exp_{i}.RData")), envir = globalenv()))
  analysis_data <- list(filter(exp_1, treatable == 1), filter(exp_2, include == 1), exp_3, exp_4)
  refit <- function(experiment, outcome, covariates) {
    fit <- lm(as.formula(str_glue("{outcome} ~ condition_factor + {covariates}")),
              weights = weights, data = analysis_data[[experiment]])
    round(c(unname(coef(fit)["(Intercept)"]), summary(fit)$r.squared), 3)
  }
  share_refits <- pmap(list(model_2_fits$experiment, model_2_fits$outcome, model_2_fits$share_covariates), refit)
  margin_refits <- pmap(list(model_2_fits$experiment, model_2_fits$outcome, model_2_fits$margin_covariates), refit)
  stopifnot(all(map_dbl(share_refits, 1) == model_2_fits$share_constant),
            all(map_dbl(share_refits, 2) == model_2_fits$share_r2),
            all(map_dbl(margin_refits, 1) == model_2_fits$margin_constant),
            all(map_dbl(margin_refits, 2) == model_2_fits$margin_r2))
}

fit_evidence <- function(tables) {
  model_2_fits |>
    filter(table %in% tables) |>
    mutate(sentence = str_glue("Table {table} prints {fmt(printed_constant)} and {fmt(printed_r2)}; vote shares give {fmt(share_constant)} and {fmt(share_r2)}, and vote margins give {fmt(margin_constant)} and {fmt(margin_r2)}.")) |>
    pull(sentence) |>
    str_c(collapse = " ")
}
```

```{r entries}
# THE ERRATA SPINE. Every entry is defined once, here, and rendered from here: into this
# document, and into whatever else needs it, which reads the errata_entries.csv written at
# the bottom of this file rather than keeping a second hand-typed copy.
#
# [[...]] marks the span that changes. Each renderer supplies its own markup for it: bold
# here, \was{} in an edition. Nothing else in a field is markup, so the same string can be
# set by either.
#
# Numbering follows PROCEDURES.md Stage 4b: entries are ordered by severity block (quantity;
# description, interpretation, definition; label, float, cross_reference; wording, spelling,
# typography; bibliographic), discovery order inside a block, and a finding that lands in an
# earlier block renumbers the entries after it. Renumbered 2026-11-07; the old-to-new map is
# in that day's commit message.
#
# claim_ids names the ground-truth rows an entry corrects, semicolon-separated.
#
# Entry 24 is a note (decision 15): it corrects nothing, so its corrected field is NA.
#
# corrected_values runs parallel to claim_ids, one value per id in the same order, carrying
# the corrected quantity as a number rather than as a sentence, on the claim's scale. Each
# value comes from the same expression that glues the sentence, so the two cannot be written
# apart, and the gate below re-checks that each one is still inside the span it belongs to.
# An entry of a class that changes no quantity, and a note, carries NA.
# Entry 1 names 38 ids, and its corrected sentence carries numbers for the first seven (the
# spillover estimates, the RI p-value, Pr(ATE > 0), and the pooled interaction). Those seven
# store their values, and the other 31, table and figure cells listed in the note, store NA
# positions (Alex, 2026-11-05, review queue rows 6 and 7). Only entry 1 may hold one.
entry_1_values <- c(percent_points(c(spillover_m1, spillover_m1_se, spillover_m2, spillover_m2_se)),
                    sprintf("%.2f", ri_p), percent_points(agnostic_pr), fmt(indirect_interaction),
                    rep("NA", length(entry_1_claims) - 7))
entries <- tribble(
  ~entry, ~class, ~source, ~form, ~title, ~location, ~published, ~corrected, ~note, ~claim_ids, ~corrected_values,

  1, "quantity", "pipeline", "full",
  "Experiment 1 adds vote shares together across merged precincts",
  "p. 147, Section 5.1 and Table 3; p. 148, Section 6, Table 7, and Figure 2; app. p. 7, Section D; app. p. 8, Table D.5",
  "the estimated spillover effect is [[3.7]] percentage points (robust SE = [[2.7]]). ... The estimated spillover effect [[decreases]] to [[1.8]] percentage points, and its standard error falls to [[1.6]] percentage points. Using randomization inference, we fail to reject the joint null hypothesis of no direct or indirect effects (p = [[0.22]]). ... there is a [[98.8]] percent chance that lawn signs increase the vote share of the advertising candidate. ... The estimated average interaction effect for the indirect treatment is [[0.007]], with a standard error of 0.007.",
  str_glue("the estimated spillover effect is [[{percent_points(spillover_m1)}]] percentage points (robust SE = [[{percent_points(spillover_m1_se)}]]). ... The estimated spillover effect [[increases]] to [[{percent_points(spillover_m2)}]] percentage points, and its standard error falls to [[{percent_points(spillover_m2_se)}]] percentage points. Using randomization inference, we fail to reject the joint null hypothesis of no direct or indirect effects (p = [[{sprintf('%.2f', ri_p)}]]). ... there is a [[{percent_points(agnostic_pr)}]] percent chance that lawn signs increase the vote share of the advertising candidate. ... The estimated average interaction effect for the indirect treatment is [[{fmt(indirect_interaction)}]], with a standard error of 0.007."),
  str_c("The Experiment 1 analysis computes each precinct's vote shares and then sums its columns across the precincts merged for assignment, so the four merged units carry the sum of two shares: their outcomes are 0.658, 0.802, 0.894, and 0.739 where the shares of their summed votes are 0.328, 0.398, 0.433, and 0.367, and their covariates reach 1.171. All four units are in the adjacent group, which is why the unadjusted spillover estimate is the number that moves most. The corrected values take the merged units' shares from their summed vote counts, by the deposited script's own definitions, which return the deposited value for every other unit. The direct effect in Table 3 stays at 0.025 in both models, the pooled estimates in Table 7 stay at 0.017 and 0.015 with standard errors of 0.007 and 0.006, and the paper's conclusions stand. The vote margin and turnout results use counts and are unaffected. The printed tables report the deposited objects faithfully, so the error is in the analysis rather than in their transcription. Every printed cell that moves follows. ", changed_list),
  str_c(entry_1_claims, collapse = ";"),
  str_c(entry_1_values, collapse = ";"),

  2, "description", "reading", "full",

# Gate: corrected_values agrees with the sentence it was glued into ----
# The column and the sentence are written from one expression, so they begin in agreement
# and this gate exists for the edit that separates them: a value moved from one marked span
# to another, a span reworded to carry a second number, a claim id appended without its
# value. Each value has to be inside the span it belongs to, matched by position where the
# counts line up, and inside SOME span where an entry marks a label as well as a number and
# its spans outnumber its values. The spelled form is tolerated ("four" for 4), and so is a
# thousands separator. An NA position has no span to be inside.
marked_spans <- function(x) str_match_all(x, "\\[\\[(.*?)\\]\\]")[[1]][, 2]
gate_words <- c("zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten")
in_span <- function(v, s) {
  s <- str_remove_all(s, ",")
  spelled <- if (str_detect(v, "^[0-9]+$") && as.integer(v) < length(gate_words)) gate_words[as.integer(v) + 1] else v
  str_detect(s, fixed(v)) || str_detect(s, fixed(spelled))
}

quantified <- entries |>
  filter(!is.na(corrected_values)) |>
  mutate(ids = str_split(claim_ids, ";"), values = str_split(corrected_values, ";"),
         spans = map(corrected, marked_spans))

stopifnot(all(lengths(quantified$ids) == lengths(quantified$values)))

value_placed <- pmap_lgl(quantified, function(...) {
  e <- list(...)
  values <- e$values[e$values != "NA"]
  if (length(values) == length(e$spans)) {
    all(map2_lgl(values, e$spans, in_span))
  } else {
    all(map_lgl(values, \(v) any(map_lgl(e$spans, \(s) in_span(v, s)))))
  }
})

if (!all(value_placed)) {
  print(quantified |> filter(!value_placed) |> select(entry, title, corrected_values, corrected))
  stop("An entry's corrected_values are not in the spans of its corrected sentence.")
}

# An entry that changes a quantity has to say which one, and an entry that changes none, or
# a note, may not carry a value. The class is the declaration and this is where it binds.
# Empty claim_ids is stored as "" and counts as missing.
no_claim <- is.na(entries$claim_ids) | entries$claim_ids == ""
stopifnot(
  all(!is.na(entries$corrected_values[entries$class == "quantity" & entries$form != "note" & !no_claim])),
  !any(str_detect(entries$corrected_values[entries$entry != 1], "(^|;)NA(;|$)"), na.rm = TRUE),
  all(is.na(entries$corrected_values[entries$class != "quantity" | entries$form == "note"])),
  all(is.na(entries$corrected_values) | !no_claim)
)


# The spine's markup, resolved for this document. Another renderer resolves it differently.
bold <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "\\[\\[(.*?)\\]\\]", "**\\1**")

# A heading is only a heading when a blank line precedes it, which is why every emitted
# entry opens with one.
emit_entry <- function(n) {
  e <- entries |> filter(entry == n)
  cat("\n\n## ", e$entry, ". ", e$title, "\n\nPublished, ",
      str_remove(e$location, "^published "), ":\n\n> ", bold(e$published), sep = "")
  if (e$form != "note") cat("\n\nCorrected:\n\n> ", bold(e$corrected), sep = "")
  cat("\n\n", e$note, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

This note lists `r sum(entries$form != "note")` corrections and one unresolved citation in "The effects of lawn signs on vote outcomes: Results from four randomized field experiments," published in *Electoral Studies* 41:143--150, doi [10.1016/j.electstud.2015.12.002](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.electstud.2015.12.002), and its online appendix. **One correction changes printed estimates, and it changes neither the pooled results nor the paper's conclusions.** The Experiment 1 analysis adds vote shares together across merged precincts, which inflates the unadjusted spillover estimate from `r percent_points(spillover_m1)` to 3.7 percentage points. Two further corrections fix misdescribed covariates: the article calls its vote shares margins, and the appendix calls its margins vote shares. The rest are smaller matters of description, labelling, and reference, along with words dropped, doubled, or misspelled.

The first entry came from tracing the deposited analysis code, and its corrected values are computed from the deposited replication archive, doi [10.7910/DVN/K2TLDB](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/K2TLDB), by the maintained analysis. The others came from reading the article and its appendix word by word, except the Ansolabehere and Iyengar pages, which came from Crossref. Each quotation was checked against an image of the published page. The figures in the notes to entries 2 and 5 are refit from the archive whenever this document is rendered with the archive present. The code supporting the maintained analysis is at [github.com/active-maintenance-aec/green_etal_2016](https://github.com/active-maintenance-aec/green_etal_2016).

```{r render-entries, results="asis"}
walk(entries$entry[entries$class != "bibliographic"], emit_entry)
```

# The reference list

```{r reference-entries, results="asis"}
walk(entries$entry[entries$class == "bibliographic"], emit_entry)
```

```{r emit-spine}
# The machine-readable spine, written wherever this document is rendered. Anything else
# that needs these entries reads it rather than keeping its own copy, so the two cannot
# drift.
# The spine's vocabularies are closed (cleanup of 2026-11-07): a value outside them is a
# typo, and the edition builders read these columns to shape every entry.
stopifnot(
  all(entries$class %in% c("quantity", "description", "interpretation", "definition", "label", "float", "cross_reference", "wording", "spelling", "typography", "bibliographic")),
  all(entries$form %in% c("full", "brief", "note")),
  all(entries$source %in% c("pipeline", "reading", "reference_audit", "publisher_record", "authors_archive", "proof"))
)
write_csv(entries, here("errata_entries.csv"))
```
